items.q: like Tommy and Jimmy. They didn't get along until after their mother got them together

ctx.x: Oh, you know, what he did to Fletcher -- well, of course, his brother's peculiar, you know. Now, take, for instance -- I know three, four different brothers' band, never got along so good, like Tommy and Jimmy. They didn't get along until after their mother got them together after their father died. And she laid the law down to them.
The Tommy and Jimmy thing was a little different, wasn't it? I mean that was like, you know, they'd kind of fight, but it --
